summary: Post-fix live acceptance of the feed (on-this-day) surface after repairing path-param substitution: feed previously sent literal {type}/{month} segments and read day from args[2], so every invocation failed. Live matrix against en.wikipedia.org REST: feed 9 --month 6 --agent (200, JSON envelope), --type events and --type=deaths variants (200), required-month error, legacy 3-positional form rejected with usage error, day/month range validation, and MCP feed_get-on-this-day with unpadded month/day and omitted type (defaults to all, zero-padded, 200). Non-feed commands unchanged by this fix; original full acceptance for this run predates the phase5 marker artifact.
